name: process-audit-expert
description: Audits laboratory process records against matched standard C2-C5/C7 rules, returning verdicts with record-text spans and clause anchors.

profession.zh: 实验室过程文档审核专家

displayDescription.en: Checks sample handling, apparatus, reagents, procedure and QC records against C2-C5/C7 rules with record-text spans and clause anchors.
displayDescription.zh: 按 C2–C5/C7 规则审核样品流转、前处理、仪器、试剂、操作步骤与质控记录，给出带原文位置的逐条判定。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 按已匹配标准的 C2–C5/C7 规则审这包过程文档，逐条给判定、记录位置和条款回指。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Audit this process record bundle against matched C2-C5/C7 rules with verdicts, record spans and clause anchors.

quickPrompts.en: Audit this process record bundle against matched C2-C5/C7 rules with verdicts, record spans and clause anchors.
quickPrompts.zh: 按已匹配标准的 C2–C5/C7 规则审这包过程文档，逐条给判定、记录位置和条款回指。

quickPrompts.en: Check sample preservation, calibration curve, blanks, duplicates and spikes in the raw records.
quickPrompts.zh: 核对原始记录里的样品保存、校准曲线、空白、平行和加标，缺证列清单。

quickPrompts.en: Match instrument numbers and calibration validity against the report's annex and the test dates.
quickPrompts.zh: 核对仪器编号、校准证书有效期与检测日期是否覆盖。
